title: Dashboard
text: Dashboard · potatosips ps potatosips RedBot Guide Home Install Core Setup Customization Troubleshooting Search Menu Home Install Core Setup Customization Troubleshooting Guide Home Install Core Setup Customization Troubleshooting Cogs Welcome RoleTools Tickets AutoRoom Retrigger Snipe ExtendedModLog YALC Voice Logs Dashboard Birthday AutoReact Web Dashboard Dashboard cog setup with a separate venv so the RedBot venv stays clean. 1. Create dashboard venv Copy python3.11 -m venv ~/redbotdashboard source ~/redbotdashboard/bin/activate pip install -U pip wheel setuptools pip install git+https://github.com/AAA3A-AAA3A/Red-Web-Dashboard.git pip install flask-wtf==1.2.1 2. Enable RPC in RedBot systemd The instance name comes from redbot-setup . If your service is red@YOUR_INSTANCE_NAME , keep using that name. Copy ExecStart=/home/ubuntu/redenv/bin/python -O -m redbot %i --owner YOUR_DISCORD_USER_ID --team-members-are-owners --no-prompt --rpc Copy sudo systemctl daemon-reload sudo systemctl restart red@YOUR_INSTANCE_NAME 3. Configure Dashboard cog Run in DM with the bot after adding the redirect URI in Discord Developer Portal. Copy oa setdashboard redirecturi https://YOUR_DASHBOARD_DOMAIN/callback oa setdashboard secret YOUR_CLIENT_SECRET 4. Caddy reverse proxy Copy YOUR_DASHBOARD_DOMAIN { reverse_proxy localhost:42356 } Copy sudo systemctl restart caddy 5. Dashboard systemd service Copy [Unit] Description=Red-Web-Dashboard After=network-online.target red@YOUR_INSTANCE_NAME.service Wants=network-online.target [Service] User=ubuntu Group=ubuntu ExecStart=/home/ubuntu/redbotdashboard/bin/reddash --host localhost --port 42356 Restart=on-abnormal RestartSec=15 [Install] WantedBy=multi-user.target Copy sudo systemctl daemon-reload sudo systemctl enable reddash sudo systemctl start reddash sudo systemctl status reddash Close Built for potatosips · redbot-guide.potatosips.oporajita.win Prefix used in examples: oa

title: YALC
text: YALC · potatosips ps potatosips RedBot Guide Home Install Core Setup Customization Troubleshooting Search Menu Home Install Core Setup Customization Troubleshooting Guide Home Install Core Setup Customization Troubleshooting Cogs Welcome RoleTools Tickets AutoRoom Retrigger Snipe ExtendedModLog YALC Voice Logs Dashboard Birthday AutoReact YALC Yet Another Logging Cog. Current recommended setup: keep YALC loaded, but enable only voice state logging. Final clean state: Enabled events: 1 , voice_state_update points to your voice log text channel, and validation shows 0 issues. Install Copy oa repo add taakoscogs https://github.com/TaakoOfficial/TaakosCogs oa cog install taakoscogs YALC oa load YALC Initial setup This creates the YALC Logs category and all default log channels. Use it once for a full setup. Copy oa yalc setup CONFIRM Keep only voice join/leave logs If full setup enabled too many logs, disable everything first, then enable only voice state logging. Copy oa yalc bulk_disable all oa yalc enable voice_state_update oa yalc setchannel voice_state_update VOICE_LOG_TEXT_CHANNEL_ID oa yalc validate oa yalc settings Use the text channel ID where you want voice join, leave, move, mute, deafen, stream, camera, and related voice state logs to appear. Do not bulk-enable voice unless needed voice_state_update is enough for normal voice join/leave logging. Only use bulk voice logging if you want every voice-related YALC event. Copy # Optional only if you want every voice category event oa yalc bulk_enable voice Validation notes 0 issues If oa yalc validate says found 0 issues, the setup is good. Warnings are okay Warnings like disabled events still having assigned channels are not a problem. Disabled events will not log anything unless enabled again. Diagnostics Copy oa yalc test oa yalc dashboard Avoid reset Do not run oa yalc reset unless you want to wipe YALC channel mappings and settings. Close Built for potatosips · redbot-guide.potatosips.oporajita.win Prefix used in examples: oa

title: Installation
text: Installation · potatosips ps potatosips RedBot Guide Home Install Core Setup Customization Troubleshooting Search Menu Home Install Core Setup Customization Troubleshooting Guide Home Install Core Setup Customization Troubleshooting Cogs Welcome RoleTools Tickets AutoRoom Retrigger Snipe ExtendedModLog YALC Voice Logs Dashboard Birthday AutoReact Installation Ubuntu 24.04 LTS setup for Red-DiscordBot using Python 3.11, a virtual environment, and systemd. Always keep the official Red documentation open and follow it first: docs.discord.red/en/stable . This page is the practical potatosips setup version. 1. Install Ubuntu packages Recommended base system: Ubuntu 24.04 LTS . Copy sudo apt update sudo apt -y install software-properties-common sudo add-apt-repository ppa:deadsnakes/ppa -y sudo apt update sudo apt -y install python3.11 python3.11-dev python3.11-venv git openjdk-17-jre-headless build-essential nano 2. Create RedBot virtual environment Copy python3.11 -m venv ~/redenv source ~/redenv/bin/activate pip install -U pip wheel setuptools pip install Red-DiscordBot 3. Create the bot instance Run setup and choose your instance name. In my setup the instance name was also redbot , but yours can be different. Copy redbot-setup 4. Start manually once In redbot redbot , the first redbot is the terminal command. The second redbot is the instance name made by redbot-setup . Replace the second one if your instance name is different. Copy redbot YOUR_INSTANCE_NAME --owner YOUR_DISCORD_USER_ID --team-members-are-owners 5. systemd service Create a template service so red@YOUR_INSTANCE_NAME starts the matching RedBot instance. Copy sudo nano /etc/systemd/system/red@.service Copy [Unit] Description=%i redbot After=network-online.target Wants=network-online.target [Service] User=ubuntu Group=ubuntu WorkingDirectory=/home/ubuntu ExecStart=/home/ubuntu/redenv/bin/python -O -m redbot %i --owner YOUR_DISCORD_USER_ID --team-members-are-owners --no-prompt --rpc Restart=on-failure RestartSec=20 [Install] WantedBy=multi-user.target 6. Enable and start Replace YOUR_INSTANCE_NAME with the instance name you created in redbot-setup . Copy sudo systemctl daemon-reload sudo systemctl enable red@YOUR_INSTANCE_NAME sudo systemctl start red@YOUR_INSTANCE_NAME sudo systemctl status red@YOUR_INSTANCE_NAME 7. Check logs Copy sudo journalctl -u red@YOUR_INSTANCE_NAME -n 80 --no-pager Close Built for potatosips · redbot-guide.potatosips.oporajita.win Prefix used in examples: oa

title: Troubleshooting
text: Troubleshooting · potatosips ps potatosips RedBot Guide Home Install Core Setup Customization Troubleshooting Search Menu Home Install Core Setup Customization Troubleshooting Guide Home Install Core Setup Customization Troubleshooting Cogs Welcome RoleTools Tickets AutoRoom Retrigger Snipe ExtendedModLog YALC Voice Logs Dashboard Birthday AutoReact Troubleshooting Common errors hit during the setup and the fix. Ticket button creates nothing Check bot logs. In this setup, wrong welcome placeholders caused errors. Use {owner_mention} , not {ticket_owner.mention} . Copy oa settickets welcomemessage main Hey {owner_mention}! You've opened a ticket. SUPPORT_STAFF_MENTION will be with you shortly. Ticket logs posting in panel channel Move logs to your chosen log text channel. Copy oa settickets logschannel main LOG_TEXT_CHANNEL_ID Button says “secondary Open a Ticket” The style must be a number. Copy oa settickets clearmessage BOT_PANEL_MESSAGE_ID oa settickets addbutton BOT_PANEL_MESSAGE_ID main 🎫 2 Open a Ticket Welcome says 2th The cog does not auto-format ordinals. Use “soul number {count}”. YALC voice logs not showing Run full setup, then set the voice event to your chosen voice log text channel. Copy oa yalc setup CONFIRM oa yalc setchannel voice_state_update VOICE_LOG_TEXT_CHANNEL_ID RedBot command confusion In redbot YOUR_INSTANCE_NAME , redbot is the terminal command and YOUR_INSTANCE_NAME is the instance made in redbot-setup . Close Built for potatosips · redbot-guide.potatosips.oporajita.win Prefix used in examples: oa
